outcomes: A new server-rendered React application starts from the pages it renders and a test beside it, and putnami lint and putnami test report nothing to fix before the user edits a line
A change to the template or to the framework it uses that breaks this promise fails the template proof, before a user creates a project from it
nonGoals: Packaging the template, its archive contents and the render rules, which tooling/project-scaffolding owns
Resolving packages from a registry: the proof links this repository's framework sources, so a rendered project is proven against the framework it is released with (ADR 0006)
Building the generated serve entry or running putnami serve, which the proof does not run

requirements.text: A project rendered from typescript-web passes the Biome check putnami lint runs, with the TypeScript extension's config/biome.json and the .gitignore putnami init writes, and Biome reports no warning.

A project rendered from typescript-web type-checks the way build~types does, against the packages its package.json declares and no other, after the preBuild hooks of those packages have run and each certified a complete route evaluation.
A project rendered from typescript-web ships a test beside the pages it renders, and bun test passes in it against the packages it declares.
